entries.desc: A live authority runner with valid customer key and runner identity receives a jobs.available SSE event and immediately attempts the existing signed claim path.

evidence.note: Smoke verifies long-lived SSE with standalone heartbeat chunk followed by later jobs.available chunk returns jobs_stream ok and still performs signed claim.

entries.desc: If the stream returns a single snapshot with no jobs, disconnects, times out, or is not text/event-stream, the CLI falls back to existing polling without blocking the runner forever.

evidence.note: Reader ignores heartbeat/comment/non-jobs blocks and continues until jobs.available, stream close, timeout, malformed event, or configured limits; fallback cases still pass.

entries.desc: A jobs.available event is never treated as a leased job; the CLI must still require claim success before execution and must not claim productionDone or receipt verification from SSE alone.

evidence.note: Positive SSE jobIds, including late jobs.available, do not create ownership when signed claim returns {job:null}; claimedJobId/releasedJobId remain null.

entries.desc: The SSE request carries the same Authority customer API key source as other protected Authority reads and works for codex/claude runner identities without provider-specific shortcuts.

evidence.note: SSE request still uses configured customer API key source; heartbeat-first stream handling remains provider-neutral and proceeds to signed claim.

entries.desc: 401/403/404/server-unavailable stream failures produce a clear readiness/fallback diagnostic and continue through the configured safe fallback path where appropriate, without printing raw Authorization headers or customer API keys.

evidence.note: Timeout/fallback diagnostics remain redacted; read operations are tied to abort signal and still respect configured timeout.

entries.desc: Provider-specific or host-specific assumptions cannot bypass runner registration, heartbeat, session binding, claim ownership, existing execution boundaries, or secret redaction for Authorization/customer API key material.

evidence.note: Runner registration, heartbeat, and signed claim remain required; jobs_stream never bypasses session/claim ownership.

entries.desc: Docs state how the CLI uses runner jobs SSE, what server capability is required, and how fallback behaves.

evidence.note: Docs remain accurate: runner jobs SSE is a notification hint and signed claim remains authority/fallback path.

entries.desc: Docs clarify that retired Orchestrate is read-only legacy evidence and canonical proofbound is the mutating development root.

evidence.note: Docs still keep canonical mutating workflow under proofbound and forbid new jobs_stream writes under retired Orchestrate.

entries.desc: Docs do not overclaim faster provider execution, Authority completion, productionDone, or server-side push support before the server endpoint actually provides it.

evidence.command: rg -n "not evidence of approval|not production authority|notification hint before claim|must not claim" docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-authority-live-integration.md
evidence.note: Docs still do not overclaim jobs_stream as receipt verification, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone.
